\expandafter\def\csname n@v11:ae:abstract\endcsname{On eight AliMeeting meetings never used before, a locked test confirms the speech-layer gains: ASR-BLEU +2.23, block-start speech LAAL $-$0.37\,s, EndOffset $-$1.43\,s.}
\expandafter\def\csname n@v11:ae:hours\endcsname{4.2}
\expandafter\def\csname n@v11:ae:verdict\endcsname{Against B, \sys{} changes ASR-BLEU by +2.23, the conventional block-start speech LAAL by $-$0.37\,s and EndOffset by $-$1.43\,s (all three tests fixed in the analysis plan confirmed after Holm correction); speech start moves by $-$0.14\,s and the speaking rate rises from 2.36 to 3.50 words per second. The pause cost replicates as well.}
\expandafter\def\csname n@v11:ae:wa\endcsname{Write alignment changes text tcpBLEU by $-$0.29 ($-$0.59 to +0.09; step 4{,}000: $-$0.12) and ASR-BLEU by $-$0.10, exploratory comparisons.}
\expandafter\def\csname n@v11:asr2:gain:ali\endcsname{+0.93$^{*}$}
\expandafter\def\csname n@v11:asr2:gain:ami\endcsname{+1.32$^{*}$}
\expandafter\def\csname n@v11:asr2:gain:en\endcsname{+3.74$^{*}$}
\expandafter\def\csname n@v11:fact:verdict\endcsname{Against R3$^\prime$, \sys{} changes ASR-BLEU by +0.11 / +0.05 / +0.23 ($p_\text{Holm}$ 0.895 / 0.895 / 0.007) and LAAL$_\text{block}$ by at most 0.003\,s (none significant): most of the gain comes from the backlog-dependent rate (paired differences, R2$-$R1 +1.55 / +0.24 / +0.80) and candidate selection (R3$-$R2 +0.40 / +0.35 / +0.33; exploratory), and the learned Talker adds a significant gain only on AliMeeting.}
\expandafter\def\csname n@v11:flu:app\endcsname{On development meetings PA-F keeps ASR-BLEU in Zh$\rightarrow$En (+0.05) but not in En$\rightarrow$Zh ($-$0.09, with $P(\Delta\le0)\ge0.95$ it fails the gate), so only the Zh$\rightarrow$En Talker was tested. On test it changes ASR-BLEU by +0.03 on AMI and $-$0.13 on AliMeeting (95\% interval [$-$0.24, $-$0.01]).}
\expandafter\def\csname n@v11:metricsv:app\endcsname{Against B, \sys{} gains on the second recogniser by +1.32$^{*}$ / +3.74$^{*}$ / +0.93$^{*}$ and in speech COMET by +2.58$^{*}$ / +0.34$^{*}$ / +1.47$^{*}$ (AMI Zh$\rightarrow$En / En$\rightarrow$Zh / AliMeeting); text COMET is unchanged by construction. The En$\rightarrow$Zh second-recogniser gain is much larger than with Paraformer because Whisper fails more often on B's audio (repetition loops or hallucinated phrases in 16\% of B's utterances against 6\% of \sys{}'s; +6.46 before removing them), so only its sign is informative. \sys{}+WA differs from \sys{} on neither metric significantly.}
\expandafter\def\csname n@v11:pr:test:ali:e2-b:ratepct\endcsname{48}
\expandafter\def\csname n@v11:pr:test:ami:e2-b:ratepct\endcsname{45}
\expandafter\def\csname n@v11:pr:test:en:e2-b:ratepct\endcsname{29}
\expandafter\def\csname n@v11:s4000:summary\endcsname{text tcpBLEU $-$0.26 / $-$0.13 / $-$0.20 and ASR-BLEU $-$0.33 / $-$0.09 / $-$0.33 against step 3{,}500, lower on all three sets}
\expandafter\def\csname n@v11:wacurve:verdict\endcsname{Near the deadline operating point the two curves meet (tcpBLEU, +WA vs.\ B: Zh$\rightarrow$En 28.25 at 3.16\,s against 28.11 at 3.07\,s; En$\rightarrow$Zh 42.29 against 42.45, both at 2.45\,s); at lower lag the write-aligned Thinker falls below the deadline Thinker (Zh$\rightarrow$En 14.66 against 19.26 at 1.95\,s; En$\rightarrow$Zh 33.93 at 1.90\,s against 36.07 at 1.86\,s). Write alignment does not extend the deadline model's quality--latency frontier.}
\expandafter\def\csname n@v11:wc:app\endcsname{The Thinker is the bottleneck: reads take longer than the 1\,s cadence 33--45\% of the time and the queue of unprocessed reads builds up in the densest meetings (one AliMeeting meeting needs 1.46\,s per second), while the Talker uses about a third of real time or less. Incremental encoding of the audio prefix (a KV cache across reads) and batching speakers would address the Thinker; we did not implement either.}
\expandafter\def\csname n@v11:wc:verdict\endcsname{Replayed with measured compute times on one GPU per system, \sys{}'s Thinker needs 0.65 / 0.80 / 1.20\,s of computation per second of meeting (AMI Zh$\rightarrow$En / En$\rightarrow$Zh / AliMeeting) and its PA Talker 0.18 / 0.26 / 0.31; computation delays the median block's end by a further 3.4 / 2.9 / 52.8\,s, and the delay grows over a meeting, so as implemented (batch-1 decoding that re-encodes the prefix at every read) it does not keep up in real time}
